All three open items in this family shipped in #2608 (`4f5b791`), each runtime-verified against a live showcase server with the before/after/restart harness described above:

1. **Authored actions' handler never ran — CONFIRMED broken, now fixed.** The probe reproduced the gap exactly as hypothesized (`POST /actions/... → Action not found` for a published `action` row). Fixed by reusing the #2596 template: default QuickJS action runner installed by AppPlugin (`engine.setDefaultActionRunner`, opt-out `OS_DISABLE_AUTHORED_ACTIONS=1`) + `resyncAuthoredActions` in ObjectQLPlugin (kernel:ready / metadata:reloaded / action+object mutations; artifact-wins filter; covers standalone `action` rows AND actions embedded in authored object rows). Verified live: body executes on publish and after restart.
2. **i18n translations (#2591)** — closed by the PR. Note for the audit record: the first cut wired only service-i18n and the runtime probe caught it doing nothing, because dev/standalone stacks run the kernel's in-memory i18n fallback — the fix now covers both adapters via a shared sync in core (`wireAuthoredTranslationSync`), with clear-then-reload delete semantics verified live.
3. **Sharing-rule data-change rebind (#2592)** — closed by the PR. Verified live: first runtime rule for an object with zero boot-time rules produced a `sys_record_share` row on the next matching insert, no restart.

Residual (not chased here): standalone authored `action` items execute via the REST route but aren't discoverable via MCP `run_action`/`list_actions`, since those resolve declarations from `object.actions` — same declaration-surfacing gap as the Studio-rail listing work (`task_8dd7c8a0`). Object-embedded authored actions are covered on both surfaces.

## Re-evaluation against latest `main` (`93fd58e`, 2026-07-16)

Re-audited every item in this umbrella against current code. **Verdict: all three family members remain fixed on main, all sub-issues and cross-references are closed, and the one residual gap is now tracked separately (#3010) — this tracking issue can be closed.**

### 🟢 The three fixes are all present on main, each with a dedicated regression test

1. **Authored actions** — `resyncAuthoredActions` is live in the ObjectQL plugin with all three triggers (kernel:ready `plugin.ts:259`, metadata:reloaded `:377`, action/object mutations `:389`), serialized resyncs, full-replace semantics (`removeActionsByPackage('metadata-service')` then re-register), artifact-wins filtering, and coverage of both standalone `action` rows and object-embedded ones (`resyncAuthoredActionsNow`, `plugin.ts:1338`). The default QuickJS runner is installed by AppPlugin (`app-plugin.ts:263`) with the `OS_DISABLE_AUTHORED_ACTIONS=1` opt-out, and a loud warning fires if authored actions exist with no runner installed. Test: `packages/objectql/src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`.
2. **Authored translations (#2591, closed)** — `wireAuthoredTranslationSync` lives in core (`packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts`) and is wired by **both** hosts (AppPlugin for the kernel in-memory fallback, `I18nServicePlugin` for the file adapter, `i18n-service-plugin.ts:126`), with an ownership marker so double-wiring no-ops. Clear-then-reload delete semantics; triggers on kernel:ready, metadata:reloaded, and the `onMetadataMutation` stream. Test: `packages/services/service-i18n/src/authored-translations.test.ts`.
3. **Sharing-rule data-change rebind (#2592, closed)** — `sharing-plugin.ts:171` binds afterInsert/afterUpdate/afterDelete triggers on `sys_sharing_rule` that re-run the full unbind+`bindRuleHooks` cycle, serialized and fail-safe (previous bindings kept on rebind failure). Test: `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/rule-rebind.test.ts`.

The hooks template fix (#2588/#2596) is also still intact: `setDefaultBodyRunner` is called at `app-plugin.ts:225`.

### 🟢 Cross-references all resolved since the last update

- **#2585** (run observability follow-ups) — closed 2026-07-08.
- **objectui #2245** (off-spec nav `kind`/`path`) — closed 2026-07-05.
- **Studio rail listing (`task_8dd7c8a0`)** — the Studio surface now reads **published ∪ draft** for package items (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1096`, `:1140`), so this appears landed.

### 🟢 The pattern got institutionalized: ADR-0096

The family's failure mode ("a schema collection the AI can author but the runtime ignores is the worst failure mode a metadata platform can ship") is now the explicit motivation of **ADR-0096 declarative connector instances** (#2977, runtime re-materialization landed in #3001 = the current `main` HEAD): declarative `connectors:` entries were exactly this class (registered as metadata, never reaching the engine registry). The fix goes further than the members here — provider-bound entries that can't materialize are a **hard boot error**, plus a `metadata:reloaded` reconcile with signature-based re-materialization. That's the "fail loudly instead of silently doing nothing" upgrade this umbrella was arguing for. Related: #2992 tracks the latent (stub) GraphQL/realtime surfaces in the same declared-vs-wired spirit.

### 🔴 The one residual → now tracked as #3010

The wrap-up comment's residual is still real on `93fd58e` and was untracked until now: standalone authored `action` rows **execute** (REST route, engine registry) but are **invisible to MCP** `list_actions`/`run_action`, because both bridge resolution paths read declarations only from `object.actions` (`http-dispatcher.ts:813`, `:1174`). Split out as **#3010** so it doesn't hold this umbrella open — it's a declaration-surfacing gap (same family as the rail-listing work), not an execution gap.

### Recommendation

With all three members shipped + regression-tested, all cross-refs closed, and the residual split into #3010, nothing remains that this issue tracks. **Recommend closing as completed.**
